symptoms: The first create response times out.
The client retries with the same business key.
possible_causes: The first request committed before its delayed response.
The create operation did not enforce idempotency.
recommended_actions: Correlate both requests by business key and request identifier.
Verify the first commit occurred before the client timeout.
validation_steps: Confirm that idempotent retry returns the original order instead of creating another.
known_workarounds: Disable automatic retry until idempotency is restored.
Enable idempotency enforcement for the create-order operation.
constraints: Synthetic test fixture only; never query a production system.
